title: Source transition under a thickening
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, $q\in\mathbf Z$, $p:X\to S$ and $g:T_2\to S$ morphisms of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and $i:T_1\to T_2$ a closed immersion surjective on points. For every etale sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda$-modules on $T_2$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], the canonical restriction transition between the sources of [sbc-def-base-change-map], $p^{-1}R^qg_*F\to p^{-1}R^q(g i)_*i^{-1}F$, is an isomorphism.

source.place: Proof, condition (1): thickenings; transition compatibility made explicit

proof.text: Apply [sbc-lem-thickening-etale-site] via the existing source theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.isEquivalence_upperStar_of_thickening. Inverse image is fully faithful, so the underived adjunction unit is invertible, and the equivalence preserves injective objects. Thus inverse image sends injectives to direct-image-acyclic objects. Apply the proved source theorem CategoryTheory.Adjunction.isIso_derivedPlus_unit_app_of_rightAcyclic, and identify derivedPlus with derivedAdjunctionPlus using derivedAdjunctionPlus_eq_derivedPlus. This proves invertibility of the actual derived adjunction unit at every bounded-below object, without constructing another equivalence.

Let c be the canonical composition isomorphism Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompIso' of Ri_* and Rg_*. Its compatibility with the composite adjunction unit [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction], normalized by the adjunction conjugate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate], is the proved source lemma Etale.derivedPlus_unit_comp_upperStarCompDerivedPlus. Expand lowerStarPlusTransition. Substitute that unit law. Naturality of c moves Li applied to the g-counit past c; naturality of the i-unit replaces eta_i followed by Ri Li epsilon_g with epsilon_g followed by eta_i. The right triangle identity for g cancels eta_g followed by Rg epsilon_g. Hence the transition equals Rg applied to eta_i, followed by c. Both factors are isomorphisms by the preceding step.

Place F in degree zero, apply the preceding two steps, and unfold baseChangeSourceTransition. Its remaining factors are the direct image of the exact inverse-image/single-functor comparison, derived inverse image along p, and degree-q homology. The comparison is a natural isomorphism and all functors preserve isomorphisms, so instance synthesis proves the required IsIso. No assumption on q, g, p, or the support of F is added.

proof_origin.place: Condition (1), thickenings; Lean proof by S1 from the existing topological-invariance theorem, the acyclic derived-unit theorem, and canonical derived unit-composition coherence. Source checked at Stacks Tags 03SI and 0F07.
